conclusion: No material defect found in the proposed isolated raw-model Rust adapter experiment. The following details must be frozen before an implementation claims to preserve the same recurrence and projection.

requirements.requirement: Bind session_ready from before the adapter/session starts. Cold startup cannot disappear merely because the Rust process is now running. A committed first skip has session_after=true; actual current call and terminal close remain charged once. sunk_cost_ns is a history/binding field in the current model, not an additional future recurrence charge; do not subtract it from the remaining budget twice or drop it from the complete campaign ledger.

The DP skip-first/lexical winner and NDU projection are distinct contracts. Any abstain in the returned frontier yields no action; conflicting ready_after/dispatch projections also yield no action. A Rust lexical argmin cannot replace this rule. Skip still retires invalid artifacts, pays holding costs, and dispatches baseline or the fastest resident artifact; it is not literal zero-effect abstain.

Reproduce each original operation order, unit and floor: instant=-(cost*Q32//1000000), terminal is independently completion_value*Q32//1000000, and resource/budget use //1000. Do not combine completion and cost before rounding. MAX_NS=1000000000000 and Q32=2^32 make a legal intermediate product exceed u64 even when its converted result fits. Use sufficiently wide checked intermediates, such as i128, instead of accidentally rejecting valid Python models or wrapping the product.

Record Rust process/session startup, raw-model DP completion, and original NDU evaluate as separate actual events. If the core is skipped, the first two still cost time. native_evaluated=false cannot mean zero invocation/setup cost. Any changed current-charge model must be separately registered rather than silently described as v2 numeric equivalence.

Retain actual wall-budget admission after new Rust search and before NDU evaluate, and again before caller prepare/dispatch. Model memory-budget bounds resident sets; it does not automatically prove peak memory while old and new artifacts coexist. Independently enforce retire/prepare order, actual allocation and runtime resource budgets.

scope_limits: These requirements govern a future separate candidate profile.
No current production bug, native speedup, NDU-specific value, whole-language safety or global-optimality proof is inferred.
Existing 1629 and 23af negative performance results and original denominators remain unchanged.
